description: This file contains the initial schema for a charging station management system, including table definitions, enums, triggers, and indexes. It sets up core data structures for users, roles, chargers, locations, bookings, payments, and notifications, tailored for both local and cloud (Supabase/Postgres) environments.

methods.name: public.set_location_geom
methods.description: Trigger function to set the geom point in charger_locations based on latitude and longitude, if PostGIS is available.

calls: EXECUTE 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis'
EXECUTE 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto'
